title: Swiss Hemophilia Registry
brief_summary: The Swiss Hemophilia Registry will collect data on the prophylactic and therapeutic use of factor concentrates in patients with hemophilia and other severe bleeding disorders in Switzerland.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Diagnosis of hemophilia or other severe bleeding disorders. Signed inform consent

Exclusion Criteria:

None
study_population: Patients with hemophilia and other severe bleeding disorders
condition: Hemophilia and Other Severe Bleeding Disorders
